extDescription.message: Moves your preferred country to the top of any country dropdown, automatically.

preferredDesc.message: These countries appear at the very top of dropdowns. Drag to change the order.

emptyPreferred.message: No country added yet — use the search field above.

blacklistDesc.message: The extension stays inactive on these domains. Wildcard * allowed.

backupDesc.message: Export your settings or restore them from a backup file.

aboutIntro.message: Country Preferred automatically moves your preferred country to the top of country dropdowns on every website — native HTML selects and custom dropdowns alike.

feat1.message: 249 countries with ISO-2/ISO-3 codes and names in many languages

feat2.message: Detects native <select> elements as well as Select2 and Choices.js

feat3.message: True reordering for React-Select & other custom dropdowns

feat4.message: Visual separator between preferred countries and the rest of the list

feat5.message: MutationObserver for dynamically loaded forms and single-page apps

feat6.message: Up to 5 preferred countries in priority order, sortable by drag and drop

feat7.message: Blacklist for individual websites, import/export of settings

feat8.message: No cloud connection, no telemetry — everything stays local

cl130.message: Multilingual interface with automatic language detection, recognizes country dropdowns in many languages

cl120.message: True reordering for custom dropdowns, visual separator, new icons, privacy policy added

cl111.message: More accessible interface with system font and higher contrast

privSummary.message: Country Preferred does not collect, store or transmit any personal data. The extension works entirely locally in your browser.

privStoredIntro.message: Only the following is stored via the browser's chrome.storage.sync API:

privStored2.message: the active/inactive state of the extension

privSync.message: This data stays within your browser profile. If your browser account sync is enabled, the browser itself syncs these settings between your devices — a browser feature, not one of the extension.

privNotTitle.message: What the extension does not do

privNot1.message: Does not send data to external servers

privNot2.message: Does not use analytics or tracking services

privNot3.message: Does not read form input, passwords or personal information

privNot4.message: Does not build usage profiles or collect telemetry

privNot5.message: Only changes the display order of dropdowns — you still make the choice

privPermStorage.message: Stores your settings locally in the browser

privPermUrls.message: Detects country dropdowns on every website

privPermNote.message: The host permission is used solely to detect and reorder dropdown elements in the page DOM. No page content is read, stored or forwarded.

privOss.message: The full source code of the extension is available — anyone can verify that these principles are followed.
